feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Reporting on the money that flows through our economy, from Wall Street financial firms to Silicon Valley tech giants, small businesses, consumers, employers and workers. Plus podcast episodes of Planet Money and The Indicator.

entry.title: Just how vulnerable are we to cyberattacks?
entry.summary: In a week of outages, we're thinking about the rising threat of AI-powered cyberattacks. But sometimes, it's not the most sophisticated attack that's concerning, but the easy targets buried in old software.

entry.title: Critics are worried about Anthropic's influence after first day of public trading
entry.summary: Anthropic's initial public offering was a success for shareholders, including its founders. But there were also protests about whether the company can be a responsible steward of AI technology.

entry.title: How exactly did Trump get so rich on crypto? We explain
entry.summary: President Trump has made billions of dollars in his second term — most of it in cryptocurrencies. Democrats are vowing to probe his businesses as they gear up to take over Congress next year.

entry.title: AI giant Anthropic's shares pop in debut after blockbuster IPO
entry.summary: Shares in the AI juggernaut Anthropic are now trading on the stock market. They debuted Thursday, after a record-breaking IPO.

entry.title: Anthropic raises more than $100B in IPO. And, Dems nominate Jeffries for House speaker
entry.summary: Despite growing concern over a possible AI bubble, Anthropic had a record-breaking initial public offering. And, Hakeem Jeffries could become the first Black Speaker of the House.

entry.title: Investors scramble for a piece of AI giant Anthropic in blockbuster IPO
entry.summary: Shares in the maker of the popular Claude artificial intelligence model leapt in first day of trading on the Nasdaq Thursday.

entry.title: Anthropic IPO raises record $81.3 billion on strong AI demand
entry.summary: The five-year-old artificial intelligence powerhouse priced its initial public offering at $83 a share, shrugging off growing concern about a possible AI bubble and volatility in tech stocks.

entry.title: Karl Kani dressed hip-hop royalty for decades. Now he's telling his own story
entry.summary: On NPR's Morning Edition, fashion designer Karl Kani talks about his new memoir, dressing some of hip-hop's biggest stars and why skinny jeans aren't for everyone.

entry.title: Nvidia hold first earnings call since former CEO's departure
entry.summary: Chip giant Nvidia held its first earnings call since the departure of former CEO Jensen Huang, as interim CEO Colette Kress takes over.

entry.title: Nvidia needs more than a new CEO. An expert offers a way forward
entry.summary: Nvidia needs a new CEO. Keeping its engineers is another story.
